f3_program: collection("governors.commencement_address_counts", "commencement_address_count", "governors", source("the three of them"))
member("governors.commencement_address_counts", "governor.sandoval.commencement_addresses.count", source("Governor Sandoval gave twice as many commencement addresses as Governor Hawkins"))
member("governors.commencement_address_counts", "governor.hawkins.commencement_addresses.count", source("Governor Sandoval gave twice as many commencement addresses as Governor Hawkins"))
member("governors.commencement_address_counts", "governor.sloan.commencement_addresses.count", source("Governor Sloan gave ten more commencement addresses than Governor Sandoval"))

multiple(at("governor.sandoval.commencement_addresses.count", "first_term"), at("governor.hawkins.commencement_addresses.count", "first_term"), 2, source("In her first term, Governor Sandoval gave twice as many commencement addresses as Governor Hawkins"))

offset(at("governor.sloan.commencement_addresses.count", "first_term"), at("governor.sandoval.commencement_addresses.count", "first_term"), 10, "count", source("Governor Sloan gave ten more commencement addresses than Governor Sandoval in the same amount of time"))
observe(at("governor.sandoval.commencement_addresses.count", "first_term"), 12, "count", source("Governor Sandoval gave 12 commencement addresses"))
query("sum", "governors.commencement_address_counts", "first_term")
assumptions: “the same amount of time” refers to the first-term interval.

f3_program: collection("lunch_rush.post_family_customers", "customer", "lunch_rush", source("The rest of the customers in the lunch rush"))
observe(at("taco_truck.soft_taco.price", "lunch_rush"), 2, "dollar_per_taco", source("soft tacos for $2"))
observe(at("taco_truck.hard_shell_taco.price", "lunch_rush"), 5, "dollar_per_taco", source("hard shell tacos for $5"))

transfer("family_hard_shell_taco_purchase", "family", at("taco_truck.hard_shell_tacos.count", "current"), at("family.hard_shell_tacos.count", "current"), 4, source("a family that buys four hard shell tacos and three soft tacos"))

transfer("family_soft_taco_purchase", "family", at("taco_truck.soft_tacos.count", "current"), at("family.soft_tacos.count", "current"), 3, source("a family that buys four hard shell tacos and three soft tacos"))
observe(at("lunch_rush.post_family_customers.count", "lunch_rush"), 10, "count", source("There were ten customers after the family"))
observe(at("lunch_rush.post_family_customers.soft_tacos.per_customer", "lunch_rush"), 2, "taco_per_customer", source("only buy two soft tacos each"))

product_relation(at("lunch_rush.post_family_customers.soft_tacos.count", "lunch_rush"), at("lunch_rush.post_family_customers.count", "lunch_rush"), at("lunch_rush.post_family_customers.soft_tacos.per_customer", "lunch_rush"), source("The rest of the customers in the lunch rush only buy two soft tacos each"))

transfer("post_family_soft_taco_purchases", "lunch_rush.post_family_customers", at("taco_truck.soft_tacos.count", "current"), at("lunch_rush.post_family_customers.soft_tacos.count", "current"), at("lunch_rush.post_family_customers.soft_tacos.count", "lunch_rush"), source("The rest of the customers in the lunch rush only buy two soft tacos each"))

product_relation(at("taco_truck.revenue.family_hard_shell_tacos", "lunch_rush"), event_field("family_hard_shell_taco_purchase", "quantity"), at("taco_truck.hard_shell_taco.price", "lunch_rush"), source("hard shell tacos for $5"))

product_relation(at("taco_truck.revenue.family_soft_tacos", "lunch_rush"), event_field("family_soft_taco_purchase", "quantity"), at("taco_truck.soft_taco.price", "lunch_rush"), source("soft tacos for $2"))

product_relation(at("taco_truck.revenue.post_family_soft_tacos", "lunch_rush"), event_field("post_family_soft_taco_purchases", "quantity"), at("taco_truck.soft_taco.price", "lunch_rush"), source("soft tacos for $2"))

sum_relation(at("taco_truck.revenue", "lunch_rush"), at("taco_truck.revenue.family_hard_shell_tacos", "lunch_rush"), at("taco_truck.revenue.family_soft_tacos", "lunch_rush"), at("taco_truck.revenue.post_family_soft_tacos", "lunch_rush"), source("How many dollars did the taco truck make during the lunch rush"))
query("value", at("taco_truck.revenue", "lunch_rush"))
assumptions: The listed dollar amounts are per-taco sale prices, and lunch-rush revenue comprises the stated purchases.

f3_program: collection("spacecraft_gibraltar.capacity.family_units", "family_unit", "spacecraft_gibraltar", source("the vehicle can carry 300 family units"))
observe(at("spacecraft_gibraltar.capacity.family_units.count", "full_capacity"), 300, "family_unit", source("At full capacity, the vehicle can carry 300 family units"))
observe(at("spacecraft_gibraltar.family_unit.people.count", "full_capacity"), 4, "person_per_family_unit", source("four people per family"))

product_relation(at("spacecraft_gibraltar.capacity.people.count", "full_capacity"), at("spacecraft_gibraltar.capacity.family_units.count", "full_capacity"), at("spacecraft_gibraltar.family_unit.people.count", "full_capacity"), source("At full capacity, the vehicle can carry 300 family units with four people per family"))

fraction_of(at("spacecraft_gibraltar.capacity.one_third.people.count", "full_capacity"), at("spacecraft_gibraltar.capacity.people.count", "full_capacity"), 1, 3, source("one-third of the ship's capacity"))

offset(at("spacecraft_gibraltar.people.count", "departure"), at("spacecraft_gibraltar.capacity.one_third.people.count", "full_capacity"), -100, "person", source("when the spacecraft leaves the earth, it will carry 100 people less than one-third of the ship's capacity"))
query("value", at("spacecraft_gibraltar.people.count", "departure"))
assumptions: “the ship's capacity” denotes the people capacity established by the stated family-unit capacity and people per family.

f3_program: collection("jorge.property.acres", "acre", "jorge.property", source("60 acres of property"))
observe(at("jorge.property.area", "last_year"), 60, "acre", source("60 acres of property"))
same(at("jorge.corn.planted_area", "last_year"), at("jorge.property.area", "last_year"), source("Last year, Jorge planted corn on all of his 60 acres of property"))
observe(at("corn.good_soil.yield_rate", "typical"), 400, "bushel_per_acre", source("corn grown on good soil yields 400 bushels per acre"))
fraction_of(at("corn.clay_rich_soil.yield_rate", "typical"), at("corn.good_soil.yield_rate", "typical"), 1, 2, source("in clay-rich soil, the yield is only half as much per acre as in good soil"))
collection("jorge.property.soil_areas", "soil_area", "jorge.property", source("One-third of Jorge's 60 acres of land is clay-rich soil and the rest is good soil"))
member("jorge.property.soil_areas", "jorge.property.clay_rich_soil.area", source("One-third of Jorge's 60 acres of land is clay-rich soil"))
member("jorge.property.soil_areas", "jorge.property.good_soil.area", source("the rest is good soil"))
partition("jorge.property.soil_areas", at("jorge.property.area", "last_year"), source("One-third of Jorge's 60 acres of land is clay-rich soil and the rest is good soil"))
fraction_of(at("jorge.property.clay_rich_soil.area", "last_year"), at("jorge.property.area", "last_year"), 1, 3, source("One-third of Jorge's 60 acres of land is clay-rich soil"))

product_relation(at("jorge.corn.clay_rich_soil.yield", "last_year"), at("jorge.property.clay_rich_soil.area", "last_year"), at("corn.clay_rich_soil.yield_rate", "typical"), source("in clay-rich soil, the yield is only half as much per acre as in good soil"))

product_relation(at("jorge.corn.good_soil.yield", "last_year"), at("jorge.property.good_soil.area", "last_year"), at("corn.good_soil.yield_rate", "typical"), source("corn grown on good soil yields 400 bushels per acre"))

sum_relation(at("jorge.corn.yield.total", "last_year"), at("jorge.corn.clay_rich_soil.yield", "last_year"), at("jorge.corn.good_soil.yield", "last_year"), source("How many bushels of corn did Jorge's land yield last year"))
query("value", at("jorge.corn.yield.total", "last_year"))
assumptions: The stated typical per-acre yields apply to Jorge's corn crop last year.

f3_program: add("jeanine_purchase", "jeanine", at("jeanine.pencils.count", "current"), 18, source("Jeanine bought 18 pencils"))
add("clare_purchase", "clare", at("clare.pencils.count", "current"), fraction(event_field("jeanine_purchase", "quantity"), 1, 2), source("Clare bought half as many pencils"))

transfer("jeanine_to_abby", "jeanine", at("jeanine.pencils.count", "current"), at("abby.pencils.count", "current"), fraction(event_field("jeanine_purchase", "quantity"), 1, 3), source("Jeanine gave one third of his pencils to Abby"))
query("difference", at("clare.pencils.count", "current"), at("jeanine.pencils.count", "current"))
assumptions: The compared pencil holdings are the quantities acquired in the stated purchases after Jeanine's transfer to Abby.
